theme: Embryonic heart morphogenesis: chambers, septa, valves and outflow tract
core_role: The shared pathways frame the early cardiogenic programme (heart tube looping, second heart field specification, neural-crest-driven outflow tract and great-artery patterning, ventricle formation) that the additional endocardial cushion, valve and septation processes then complete.

theme: T cell activation at the immunological synapse
core_role: The shared pathways frame antigen presentation and IL-12/JAK-STAT signalling as the activating inputs to T cells, whose physical execution is the polarized synapse, raft clustering and cytoskeletal reorganization in the additional set.

theme: Pre-mRNA 3'-end processing and transcription termination
core_role: The shared pathways frame the stem-loop (SLBP) processing and turnover of replication-dependent histone mRNAs as the specialized non-polyadenylated branch of the general 3'-end cleavage/polyadenylation and Pol II termination machinery.

theme: VWF-mediated platelet adhesion, activation and hemostasis
core_role: The shared pathways frame VWF binding to collagen and GPIb-IX-V and its ADAMTS13 cleavage (with disease variants) as the primary hemostatic adhesion step that triggers platelet activation, degranulation and coagulation.

theme: Histone lysine methylation and acetylation in chromatin regulation
core_role: The shared pathways frame the WDR5/KMT2 (MLL4) histone methyltransferase complexes as the methylation arm of chromatin writing, paired with acetyltransferase activity on histones and other proteins.

theme: Proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-dependent protein degradation
core_role: The shared pathways frame proteasomal proteolysis and its regulation (degron rules, ERAD control, deubiquitinating enzymes, protein destabilization) as the degradative function of the proteasome whose assembly the additional pathways describe.

theme: Circadian clock control of metabolic nuclear-receptor transcription
core_role: The shared pathways frame the BMAL1/CLOCK and ROR/REV-ERB loop together with PPARA, PGC-1alpha and other nuclear receptors as the transcriptional output linking the circadian clock to lipid metabolism and mitochondrial biogenesis.

theme: Kidney development: ureteric bud branching and nephron induction
core_role: The shared pathways frame the metanephric mesenchyme side of kidney induction, its maintenance, survival and mesenchymal-to-epithelial conversion into nephron tubules, in response to the ureteric bud and nephric duct formation in the additional set.

theme: Protein homeostasis: ubiquitin-mediated degradation versus chaperone folding
core_role: The shared pathways frame the balance between stabilizing proteins and targeting them for proteasomal degradation (including the CUL3 adaptor RHOBTB2) as the turnover side of proteostasis, complemented by TRiC/CCT folding and ubiquitination control.

theme: Thyroid hormone synthesis and transmembrane transport of substrates
core_role: The shared pathways frame iodide uptake, hormone generation and thyroid hormone membrane transport as a transporter-dependent process, sharing carrier logic with the neutral and aromatic amino acid transporters in the additional set.

theme: Semaphorin and netrin axon guidance
core_role: The shared pathways frame Sema3A-plexin and netrin repulsive and attractive signalling (via CRMPs, PAK and integrin inhibition) as the guidance cues that steer axon extension toward target innervation.

theme: Extracellular matrix assembly: collagen, elastic fibres, basement membrane
core_role: The shared pathways frame collagen synthesis, fibril organization and elastic fibre assembly as the interstitial structural matrix, complemented by basement membrane, laminin and integrin anchoring.

theme: Vitamin and cofactor uptake, transport and metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways frame riboflavin and thiamine transport and metabolism as the B1/B2 instance of micronutrient handling within a broader programme of vitamin (B12, folate, E, K) and quinone transport and metabolism.

theme: Mitochondrial gene expression: mtDNA, transcription, RNA processing, translation
core_role: The shared pathways frame mitoribosome assembly, mitochondrial rRNA/mRNA modification and translation regulation as the translational arm of mitochondrial gene expression downstream of mtDNA replication, transcription and RNA processing.

theme: TLR-driven monocyte and macrophage inflammatory response
core_role: The shared pathways frame myeloid inflammatory activation, including responses to endogenous danger ligands such as heme and oxidized LDL, as the cellular programme engaged by TLR2/4 sensing of bacterial lipids, MyD88/IRAK4 signalling and chemokine output.

theme: Viral replication cycles and host-virus interactions
core_role: The shared pathways frame the retroviral (HIV) and herpesvirus life cycle, entry, reverse transcription, integration, latency and host control of viral transcription, as the DNA-phase viruses within a broader set of viral replication and host-translation hijacking by RNA viruses.

theme: Neutrophil and monocyte innate immune activation
core_role: The shared pathways frame myeloid effector functions, neutrophil degranulation and complement-receptor signalling, as the output of innate myeloid activation defined by monocyte and neutrophil signatures.

theme: Metanephric nephron development from intermediate mesoderm
core_role: The shared pathways frame the formation of intermediate mesoderm, maintenance of the nephron progenitor mesenchyme and its mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition into tubules as the core steps of nephrogenesis whose cell differentiation and patterning the additional pathways detail.

theme: tRNA processing and modification
core_role: The shared pathways frame mitochondrial tRNA processing, 3'-end maturation and modification as the organellar branch of tRNA maturation alongside nuclear tRNA processing, splicing and fragment biogenesis.

theme: Centrosome, cilium and microtubule organization
core_role: The shared pathways frame the centriole/basal body cycle, the switch between ciliogenesis (basal body docking, cilium assembly and disassembly) and centrosome duplication, within broader microtubule organizing-centre and spindle control.

theme: T cell tolerance and regulatory T cell control
core_role: The shared pathways frame the regulatory brakes on CD4 and CD8 T cell proliferation, effector cytokines and Th17 commitment, together with Treg differentiation, as the mechanisms of peripheral tolerance.

theme: Fibroblast mechanotransduction, ECM remodelling and mesenchymal transition
core_role: The shared pathways frame mechanical and TGF-beta signalling at focal adhesions (YAP/TAZ-CCN1/CCN2, caveolin) as the stromal activation trigger that drives extracellular matrix production and epithelial-mesenchymal transition.

theme: Morphogen control of mesenchymal progenitors: Wnt, BMP, TGF-beta
core_role: The shared pathways frame Wnt signalling as one morphogen arm driving mesenchymal stem cell expansion and differentiation, alongside BMP/SMAD1 and TGF-beta/activin SMAD2/3 signalling toward skeletal fates.

theme: ER protein quality control and ER-associated degradation
core_role: The shared pathways frame ER retention, mannose trimming and export gatekeeping as the quality-control checkpoint that decides whether proteins leave the ER or are retrotranslocated to the cytosol for ERAD.

theme: Wnt-regulated osteoblast differentiation and bone formation
core_role: The shared pathways frame Wnt control of mesenchymal stem cell and osteoblast proliferation and differentiation as the upstream osteogenic step leading to bone mineralization and maturation.

theme: Catecholamine synthesis, reuptake and synaptic neurotransmission
core_role: The shared pathways frame dopamine and norepinephrine synthesis and transporter-mediated reuptake (DAT, NET and their disease variants) as the production and clearance ends of catecholaminergic synaptic transmission.

theme: Renal epithelial solute transport: urate, amino acids, organic ions
core_role: The shared pathways frame urate handling by SLC22 and SLC2A9 transporters (and renal hypouricemia) as one instance of polarized epithelial solute reabsorption in kidney and liver, alongside cystine and amino acid transport.

theme: Axon guidance and collateral sprouting
core_role: The shared pathways frame the positive and negative control of axon extension and collateral branching by repulsive guidance cues as the growth decisions shaped by Sema3A/CRMP signalling and innervation.

theme: Dendritic cell and monocyte antigen presentation
core_role: The shared pathways frame dendritic cell differentiation and antigen presentation, including CD1 lipid antigen presentation, as the functional output of the myeloid antigen-presenting identity defined by DC and monocyte surface signatures.

theme: Dendritic cell antigen presentation including CD1 lipids and TLR7/8
core_role: The shared pathways frame MHC and CD1 lipid antigen presentation, co-expressed with endosomal TLR7/8, as the antigen-presenting function of dendritic cells.

theme: Ion transport in acid-base balance and tissue mineralization
core_role: The shared pathways frame SLC4 bicarbonate transport and its defects (renal tubular acidosis, spherocytosis) as acid-base ion handling that, alongside phosphate and calcium transporters, supports enamel and tissue mineralization.

theme: Membrane transport of carboxylates and metabolic fuels
core_role: The shared pathways frame sodium-coupled uptake of succinate and other di-/tricarboxylates as one class of metabolic substrate transport, together with pyruvate, carnitine and glucose carriers, notably in the renal proximal tubule.

theme: Cell adhesion, actin stress fibres and cell migration
core_role: The shared pathways frame syndecan and focal adhesion signalling with SRF-driven stress fibre formation as the adhesion-cytoskeletal machinery that enables substrate attachment, spreading and directed migration.

theme: Methionine cycle and methyl-group metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways frame methionine synthesis, salvage and the S-adenosylmethionine cycle (with its inherited defects) as the central methyl-donor metabolism, linked to choline and carnitine metabolism.

theme: Nucleic acid sensing and type I interferon antiviral signalling
core_role: The shared pathways frame cGAMP import and cGAS-STING-driven dendritic cell cytokine production as the cytosolic DNA-sensing arm of antiviral innate immunity, alongside endosomal TLR7/8/9 sensing, interferon regulation and RNA editing.

theme: Nucleotide-sugar supply for glycosylation: sialic acid and fucose
core_role: The shared pathways frame Golgi nucleotide-sugar transporters for CMP-sialic acid and GDP-fucose, whose defects cause congenital glycosylation disorders, as the delivery step for sugar donors made by GDP-fucose biosynthesis.

theme: Mitochondrial respiration, oxidative stress and cell death
core_role: The shared pathways frame regulation of oxidative phosphorylation, electron transport and ROS production as the mitochondrial metabolic source of oxidative stress that governs apoptosis, ferroptosis and ischemic injury.

theme: Erythrocyte gas, iron, heme and metal ion transport
core_role: The shared pathways frame red cell and systemic iron, heme, oxygen/CO2 and ammonium transport (and their disorders) as erythroid-centred solute handling within a broader programme of trace-metal transport and surfactant homeostasis.

theme: p53 and DNA damage checkpoint control of the cell cycle
core_role: The shared pathways frame p53 regulation by phosphorylation and degradation, plus Cdc25A degradation, as the DNA-damage effectors that arrest the cell cycle at G2/M checkpoints.

theme: Negative regulation of IL-1 and TLR inflammatory signalling
core_role: The shared pathways frame the dampening of IL-1 family signalling and IL-1/IL-12 cytokine production as anti-inflammatory restraint on Toll/IL-1 receptor pathways, extended to TLR2/4 and LPS signalling.

theme: Activity-dependent CaMK-CREB signalling in synaptic plasticity and memory
core_role: The shared pathways frame NMDA receptor-driven calcium/CaMK cascades to CREB and AMPK as the synapse-to-nucleus signalling that underlies long-term potentiation and memory.

theme: Thymocyte development, selection and survival
core_role: The shared pathways frame the proliferation, survival and differentiation of thymocytes as the developmental substrate on which positive and negative selection and tolerance act.

theme: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways frame VLDL and chylomicron assembly, lipase-mediated remodelling and clearance as the core plasma transport of triglycerides, regulated by LXR-driven lipogenesis and lipolysis.

theme: Phosphoinositide and inositol phosphate signalling and kinase regulation
core_role: The shared pathways frame nuclear phosphoinositide and inositol pyrophosphate synthesis and AKT activation as lipid second-messenger kinase signalling, with PTEN and PAK2 regulation as its controls.

theme: Phospholipid biosynthesis, remodelling and membrane distribution
core_role: The shared pathways frame synthesis and acyl-chain remodelling of the main glycerophospholipid classes, including cardiolipin, as membrane lipid production whose transfer, scrambling and translocation the additional pathways describe.

theme: B cell activation and differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways frame B cell and activated lymphocyte transcriptional signatures as the lineage identity on which B cell proliferation, differentiation and plasma cell generation act.

theme: Amyloid-beta production, clearance and neural effects
core_role: The shared pathways frame amyloid-beta clearance and its regulation as the removal side balancing amyloid-beta production, with consequences for synaptic plasticity and microglial activation.

theme: Netrin-mediated axon guidance and sprouting
core_role: The shared pathways frame netrin signalling with attractive and repulsive control of axon extension as the guidance mechanism, extended by second-messenger signalling, collateral sprouting and sensory ganglion development.
